airport_transfers.public_option_name: S11, Düsseldorf Flughafen Terminal–Düsseldorf Hbf, ordinary VRR A single

public_price.unit: per adult second-class single within Düsseldorf
public_price.note: Preisstufe A applies within one city: https://www.rheinbahn.de/tickets-und-tarife/tarif-preisstufen. S11 terminal route: https://www.dus.com/de-de/anreisen/bus-und-bahn. Ordinary single, not a subscription or dynamically calculated eezy fare; cheapest possible check-in quote was not verified.

duration_minutes.note: Direct terminal-station service, excluding baggage collection, walking and waiting. Do not confuse with the separate long-distance airport station requiring SkyTrain.

fixed_fare_transfer.unit: per vehicle Düsseldorf Airport–any Messe Düsseldorf entrance, either direction
fixed_fare_transfer.note: Destination is the trade fair, NOT the city centre or main station. This published route price must not be used for a central-city hotel. Do not assume every surcharge condition is waived; confirm total for the selected vehicle. Preordered fixed prices to other endpoints are individually agreed within a legal corridor, not a single published airport-city fare.

taxi_tariffs.name: Düsseldorf municipal metered taxi tariff
taxi_tariffs.applicability: Düsseldorf-licensed taxis in compulsory tariff area; airport surcharge applies both to and from DUS.

base_fare.note: Schedule enacted 2025-02-26, current city legal collection. Separate large-vehicle conditions apply. Waiting is published per hour and meter tick; no per-minute value derived.

per_km.unit: per vehicle per kilometre in the named band
per_km.note: Schedule enacted 2025-02-26, current city legal collection. Separate large-vehicle conditions apply. Waiting is published per hour and meter tick; no per-minute value derived.

per_waiting_minute.note: Schedule enacted 2025-02-26, current city legal collection. Separate large-vehicle conditions apply. Waiting is published per hour and meter tick; no per-minute value derived. The applicable amount for this field was not verified; no zero or derived amount is supplied.

airport_surcharge.unit: per vehicle per journey to or from Düsseldorf Airport
airport_surcharge.note: Schedule enacted 2025-02-26, current city legal collection. Separate large-vehicle conditions apply. Waiting is published per hour and meter tick; no per-minute value derived.

published_waiting_rate.note: Published hourly amount retained without division; per_waiting_minute remains unconfirmed unless separately published.

single.note: Valid in one direction up to 90 minutes; transfers allowed, no round/return trips.
single.validity_area: Preisstufe A, Düsseldorf city tariff area; includes DUS.

day_pass.note: Rolling 24 hours from validation; second class, not calendar-day validity.
day_pass.validity_area: Preisstufe A, Düsseldorf city tariff area; includes DUS.

pass_72h.unit: per individual DüsseldorfCard for 72 consecutive hours
pass_72h.note: Bundled visitor card including transit. FAQ confirms consecutive hours from chosen start and airport coverage: https://www.visitduesseldorf.de/buchen/duesseldorfcard/duesseldorfcard-faqs. Not the wider regional PLUS card.
pass_72h.validity_area: Düsseldorf and surrounding area: brochure specifies tariff area 43 Düsseldorf Central/North and adjoining tariff areas, second-class surcharge-free trains and local buses/trams. Airport included. Exact outer boundary must follow the issuer map; not assumed to be the whole VRR.

rate.unit: per liable guest per chargeable overnight stay
rate.note: Private and business accommodation beyond basic residential need. Liability is capped at the first 21 days of an uninterrupted stay in the same establishment. No enacted/announced dated Düsseldorf rate change verified.

periods.exemptions: Minors; school/class, vocational-college and youth trips including accompanying persons. Basic residential accommodation, including avoidance of homelessness, outside scope. From the 22nd uninterrupted night in the same establishment no tax is collected.

cap.unit: taxable days per uninterrupted same-property stay
cap.note: Section 3(3); includes any already accumulated nights in this stay.

night_count_rule.note: Resolve the city-specific exemption and stay rules before counting. A null cap is not proof that no cap exists.

cheap_meal.unit: per Thekentopf goulash soup with bread at Füchschen

alternatives.unit: per sharing fish main for two
alternatives.note: VAT and service included; current website observation.

alternatives.unit: per sharing fish main for two

coffee.unit: per freshly brewed cup of coffee at Füchschen
coffee.note: Brewed coffee, not cappuccino. Named restaurant observation with VAT included.

entry_price.unit: per full-fare adult for the named admission product
entry_price.source_name: Rheinturm — observation level — official visitor information
entry_price.note: Ordinary adult admission; early/late discounts are separate. Venue explicitly permits online or on-site card purchase, so advance booking is not required.

entry_price.note: Collection-only adult ticket. Timed special-exhibition products have different prices and booking rules; not included. Collection does not require a timeslot, but an explicit advance-purchase requirement was not established.

entry_price.note: Collection-only adult ticket. Exhibition combination costs differently. Collection has no timeslot requirement; advance-purchase obligation otherwise unconfirmed. Published November closure exceptions must be checked for visit date.

unresolved: Research only: this is not the production cost schema and the app must never read it. A validated transform must reject unconfirmed and disputed records, and retain all product, geography, date, eligibility and purchase-channel restrictions on confirmed records.

research-v3: transit envelopes carry validity_area. Airport transfers use journey_legs and named taxi_tariffs categories; overall journey time, estimated taxi ranges and attraction visit durations are deliberately absent. Each taxi category has base_fare, per_km, per_waiting_minute and airport_surcharge envelopes. An optional published_waiting_rate preserves an hourly source without deriving a per-minute figure.

Prices are observations checked on the collection date, not promises for a future trip. A current official page without an explicit effective date is identified as such. No currency conversion, averages, estimated amounts or arithmetic replacement for a missing product are used. Null does not mean zero.

day_pass records only an explicitly specified validity product; service-day and consecutive-hour products must not be treated as interchangeable. pass_72h is not calculated from shorter passes. Nonexistence requires positive evidence, not an unsuccessful search.

Eating-out figures are named menu observations, not representative city averages. A published per-person menu has not been doubled to manufacture a two-person total. The midrange category is not an official restaurant classification.

The five attractions are a research selection rather than a verified popularity ranking. Booking evidence is placed in entry_price.note because the agreed boolean has no envelope. Null booking status is unknown; no availability or queue-time claim is made.

An empty accommodation_charges array means no non-statutory charge was verified in this research, not that every property is fee-free. Conditional levies must be matched to an actual property; universal=false forbids automatic addition to every trip.

Airport scope follows destination codes found in repository configuration/catalogue, not an independently verified live origin-flight schedule. Named endpoint fares are not terminal-to-hotel prices. No comparison claim is made where cheaper conditional products or alternate services remain unverified.

Airport-centre dynamic eezy price not quoted; ordinary published fare recorded without an exhaustive cheapest claim. DUS only is in the checked destination catalogue; no Weeze/NRN airport transfer has been assumed.
The conditional fixed fare is for the Messe. Do not promote it to a general airport-centre total or combine it blindly with meter components.
The Amici two-person main is disputed between two official menus. DüsseldorfCard outer boundary should be read from the issuer map for out-of-city itineraries.
Neighbouring Neuss has a separate announced tax regime from 2027, which is not a future Düsseldorf rate. Always match hotel municipality.

research-v4 adds the closed tax basis registry and calculation metadata. Conditional means the recorded formula supports only its named case with all required inputs; it does not mean a guest total is ready. Unknown basis, unsupported assessment, missing inputs and unresolved evidence must cause explicit refusal, never an average, nearest-shape mapping or zero.
